Visitors say this sacred site offers a peaceful and spiritual experience at the confluence of three rivers, with clean, well-maintained ghats and beautiful views, especially at sunset. They also highlight the opportunity to feed numerous birds, the availability of boat rides, and its significance for holy dips and rituals. Some reviews mention the boat service staff can be unprofessional.
